body.message:
Thank you for your message and for sharing your situation with us.
Unfortunately, it will not be possible to reduce the rent amount further. The best rate we can offer is AED 7,500 for 30 nights.

However, if you are genuinely interested, we can assist you by reducing the security deposit to AED 1,500. This is the only adjustment we are able to provide at this stage.

Please let us know if you would like to proceed.

Thank you for your understanding.
